description: Status of one upstream discovery provider

code.description: Language neutral reason for a disabled or unavailable provider, or a warning (null: none). docker: disabled, socket_missing, permission_denied, connection_refused, host_not_found, api_denied, timeout, invalid_docker_host, bad_status, bad_response, self_not_found, failed. dns: disabled, truncated, no_docker_dns, no_ipv4_interface, failed. history: failed.

params.description: Values for the text of code: path (socket_missing), seconds (timeout), value and problem (invalid_docker_host: unix_path, port or unsupported), status and path (bad_status), detail (failed: the raw error, not translated)

message.description: English explanation of code, for logs and API users
